control.name: reinit_dut_usb3_en
control.doc: Enable/disable USB3 to DUT on servo_v4p1. USB3 is disabled on servo_v4p1 by default due to incompatibility with some models. This control allows to manipulate USB3 state. Also it automatically enables USB3 during servod initialization. If specific DUT does not work well with servo_v4p1 and USB3, its config should include this control with 'patch' element inside. Also it should include 'clobber_ok' and overwrite 'init' value to 'disable'. Note: need to use servo FW with dut_usb3 console command available. Note: reinit_dut_usb3_en:enabled forces USB3 once after issuing. It also resets USB DUT hub, to make USB devices enumerate again as super speed. Then USB3 is only ALLOWED, which means that other parts of servo FW can change it to USB2, eg. PD stack.
